statement: ∀ (n d l h a b : ℕ) (E : ℝ), 1 < n → 0 < d → d.Coprime n → Squarefree d → l ≤ h → h < n → b < n → 0 ≤ E → ( ∀ c l h a b : ℕ, c.Coprime n → h < n → b < n → let I := Finset.Icc l h; let J := Finset.Icc a b; |((((I.product J).filter (fun (x : ℕ × ℕ) => (x.1*x.2)%n = c%n)).card : ℝ) - (I.card:ℝ)*(J.card:ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^2)| ≤ E) → let I := (Finset.Icc l h).filter (fun u => d ∣ u*(n-u)); let J := Finset.Icc a b; let R : ℝ := (2 : ℝ)^d.primeFactors.card; |((((I.product J).filter (fun (x : ℕ × ℕ) => (x.1*x.2)%n = 1)).card : ℝ) - ((h-l+1 : ℕ):ℝ)*(J.card:ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)*R/((d:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)^2))| ≤ R*(E+1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Farey 分母对与逆元筛 · HD-8007 · 把矩形误差传到带逆元标记的平方自由筛余项
plain_statement.en: New route · Farey denominator pairs and inverse sieve · HD-8007 · Transfer rectangle discrepancy to the inverse-labelled squarefree sieve

brief.zh: 逐根应用平移。即使某根超过区间上端，也只损失一个单位计数误差。每根的矩形误差至多 E，加一个长度误差后乘根数。
brief.en: Apply the shift to each root. A root above the upper endpoint costs at most one unit of discrepancy. Add the rectangle error and the length error for each root, then sum.
